nodes.description: Address of the privileged manager allowed to select option terms and operate the vault.
Address of the option contract the vault is currently shorting.
Address of the option the vault will short in the next cycle.
Timestamp after which the queued nextOption may be rolled into.
Amount of asset currently locked as collateral in the options protocol.
Cap on the total amount that can be deposited into the vault.
Withdrawal fee in wad (1e18 = 100%) applied when burning shares.
Recipient address for withdrawal fees.
Immutable collateral/premium asset of the vault.
Immutable protocol adapter used via delegatecall for options interaction.
Immutable AirSwap Swap contract used to sell option tokens.
Constant delay (1 hour) between setting nextOption and rolling to it.
Constant ratio (0.9 ether) of balance locked in the options protocol.
Immutable minimum supply for asset balance and share supply.
Constructor setting immutable asset, adapter (from factory), WETH, USDC, swap contract, decimals and minimum supply.
Initializer setting owner, feeRecipient, cap and withdrawal fee and initializing upgradeable base contracts.
onlyOwner function updating the manager address.
onlyOwner function updating the fee recipient.
onlyManager function updating the instant withdrawal fee, capped below 30%.
Payable nonReentrant entry point depositing ETH via WETH and minting shares.
nonReentrant entry point pulling `asset` via safeTransferFrom and minting shares.
Internal share-minting logic enforcing cap and minimum supply requirements.
nonReentrant entry point burning shares, unwrapping WETH and forwarding ETH with a low-level call.
nonReentrant entry point burning shares and transferring `asset` via safeTransfer.
Internal withdrawal logic computing amounts, burning shares and paying the fee recipient.
onlyManager nonReentrant function setting the next option and closing the existing short.
nonReentrant function that closes the existing short position.
Private function validating option terms, resolving the option address and setting nextOptionReadyAt.
Private function resetting currentOption/lockedAmount and delegating short close to the adapter.
onlyManager nonReentrant function rolling vault funds into a new short position.
onlyManager nonReentrant emergency function closing the current short.
onlyManager function validating and performing an AirSwap order to sell currentOption.
onlyManager function updating the deposit cap.
Public view computing withdrawable amount and fee for a share amount.
Private view computing withdrawAmount, new asset balance and new share supply.
Public view returning the maximum withdrawable shares for all users.
External view returning the maximum withdrawable amount for an account.
External view converting an asset amount into vault shares.
External view returning an account's vault balance in asset terms.
Public view returning lockedAmount plus the vault's asset balance.
Public view returning the vault's free asset balance.
View returning the vault share token decimals.
External view returning the expiry timestamp of the current option.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the manager address.
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used for authorization, deposits and withdrawals.
block.timestamp, miner-influenced value used for option readiness and expiry checks.
Low-level call forwarding ETH to msg.sender in withdrawETH after destroying the reentrancy lock state.
delegatecall through ProtocolAdapter.delegateCloseShort into the adapter contract.
delegatecall through ProtocolAdapter.delegateCreateShort into the adapter contract.
External value call IWETH.deposit{value: msg.value}() wrapping deposited ETH.
Unchecked share/withdraw arithmetic (share.mul(total).div(shareSupply)) on pooled balances.
External call SWAP_CONTRACT.swap(order) to the AirSwap contract with caller-supplied order.
External token call IERC20(asset).safeTransferFrom pulling funds from msg.sender.
External token transfer IERC20(asset).safeTransfer(feeRecipient, feeAmount) inside withdrawal.

edges.reason: onlyManager guards setWithdrawalFee so only the manager can change the fee.
onlyManager guards commitAndClose, restricting option term selection to the manager.
onlyManager guards rollToNextOption so only the manager can open a new short.
onlyManager guards the emergency close of the short position.
onlyManager guards sellOptions, the external swap of option tokens.
onlyManager guards setCap, restricting cap increases to the manager.
The modifier reads the manager state variable to authorize the caller.
msg.sender is compared against manager in the onlyManager modifier.
depositETH credits shares to msg.sender and uses msg.value.
deposit pulls asset from msg.sender via safeTransferFrom.
withdrawETH burns msg.sender shares and sends ETH back to msg.sender.
withdraw burns msg.sender shares and transfers asset to msg.sender.
_deposit mints shares to msg.sender.
_withdraw burns msg.sender shares and emits the withdrawal event for msg.sender.
closeShort is callable by any caller and uses msg.sender in the CloseShort event.
_closeShort emits CloseShort with msg.sender as the actor.
msg.sender is the recipient of the low-level value call in withdrawETH.
_setNextOption derives nextOptionReadyAt from block.timestamp plus the delay.
_closeShort requires block.timestamp to be greater than the option expiry timestamp.
rollToNextOption requires block.timestamp to be at least nextOptionReadyAt.
withdrawETH executes a low-level call forwarding ETH to msg.sender.
deposit transfers the user's asset into the vault using safeTransferFrom.
_withdraw pays the withdrawal fee to feeRecipient via safeTransfer.
_closeShort invokes delegateCloseShort through the adapter delegatecall.
emergencyWithdrawFromShort invokes delegateCloseShort through the adapter delegatecall.
rollToNextOption invokes delegateCreateShort through the adapter delegatecall.
depositETH wraps the received msg.value into WETH via IWETH.deposit.
sellOptions performs an external call to the AirSwap swap contract with a caller-supplied order.
_withdrawAmountWithShares computes withdrawAmount with mul/div on pooled balances.
withdraw calls _withdraw to compute amounts and burn shares.
withdrawETH calls _withdraw before forwarding ETH.
deposit calls _deposit to mint vault shares.
depositETH calls _deposit after wrapping ETH.
commitAndClose calls _setNextOption to set the queued option.
commitAndClose calls _closeShort to close the existing short.
closeShort calls the private _closeShort implementation.
_setNextOption resolves the option address via adapter.getOptionsAddress.
_setNextOption writes the resolved option address into nextOption.
_setNextOption writes the computed readiness timestamp into nextOptionReadyAt.
rollToNextOption sets lockedAmount to the short amount.
rollToNextOption moves nextOption into currentOption.
rollToNextOption clears nextOption after rolling.
_closeShort resets currentOption to address(0).
_closeShort resets lockedAmount to zero.
emergencyWithdrawFromShort clears currentOption.
_withdraw calls withdrawAmountWithShares to compute the payout and fee.
withdrawAmountWithShares delegates arithmetic to _withdrawAmountWithShares.
maxWithdrawableShares reads lockedAmount to compute total assets.
totalBalance adds lockedAmount to the free asset balance.
assetAmountToShares uses lockedAmount to compute total assets.
setManager writes the new manager address into the manager state variable.
setFeeRecipient writes the new fee recipient address.
setWithdrawalFee writes the new instant withdrawal fee.
setCap writes the new deposit cap.
initialize sets the initial deposit cap.
initialize hardcodes the initial withdrawal fee.
initialize sets the initial fee recipient.
constructor assigns the immutable asset address.
constructor assigns the adapter address obtained from the factory.
constructor assigns the immutable SWAP_CONTRACT address.
rollToNextOption uses lockedRatio to size the short position.
_setNextOption uses the delay constant to compute nextOptionReadyAt.
_deposit enforces the cap state variable on total deposits.
_deposit enforces the immutable MINIMUM_SUPPLY on balances and shares.
newManager parameter controls the privileged manager role.
newFeeRecipient parameter controls where withdrawal fees are sent.
newWithdrawalFee parameter sets the fee applied to every withdrawal.
amount parameter is pulled from the caller as deposit.
share parameter is burned by withdraw.
share parameter is burned by withdrawETH before the ETH value call.
optionTerms parameter selects the option to queue in commitAndClose.
optionTerms parameter is validated and used to resolve the option address.
order parameter is validated then forwarded to the AirSwap contract.
newCap parameter sets the deposit cap controlling vault inflows.
shortAmount local is the amount delegated to the adapter to open the short.
withdrawAmount local is the ETH value forwarded to msg.sender in withdrawETH.

normalization_plan.reason: newManager is only used by setManager, so it folds into that core function.
newFeeRecipient is only used by setFeeRecipient, so it folds into that core function.
newWithdrawalFee is only used by setWithdrawalFee, so it folds into that core function.
amount is the deposit input consumed by the core deposit function.
share is the burn input consumed by the core withdraw function.
share is the burn input consumed by the core withdrawETH function.
optionTerms flows directly into _setNextOption where the option is validated and resolved.
order flows directly into sellOptions and the AirSwap external call.
newCap is only used by setCap, so it folds into that core function.
shortAmount is a pure intermediate of rollToNextOption feeding the adapter delegatecall.
withdrawAmount is a pure intermediate of withdrawETH feeding the low-level value call.
